_comment_cell_id: cell_id left as 0 — Frida v2 attempted parentCell at +0x60 which is wrong; offsets.h says PARENT_CELL_OFF=0xB8. Re-capture with the right offset is straightforward but not blocking for MVP (interest management is B6.7+).
_comment_caveat: Coords are SNAPSHOTS at capture moment. Patrol waypoints are 1000-unit horizontal segments — the NavMesh may not permit these exact paths (walls, fences, etc.) so NPCs may visually bump or stutter on collisions. Sync correctness across clients is verifiable regardless; smooth navigation needs B6.5w-extra3 (NavMesh extraction).
_comment_speeds: walk_speed_ftps is misnamed — the brain multiplies it by dt_s directly to advance world units. 100.0 = 100 units/sec ≈ vanilla walk pace.
